rationale.consistency: License headers, module registration, interface guards, //nolint:bodyclose, humanize/strconv parsing all match sibling handlers; comment style deviates with very long single-line doc comments.
rationale.edge_cases: MinRate with Timeout<=0 yields a deadline at start, so first I/O times out immediately (doc says rate needs timeout, code enables it alone); route handler ignores server hard timeouts, and the server's default 1m wrapper resets after it, overriding shorter route deadlines.
rationale.scope: Deletes request_body's existing read_timeout/write_timeout JSON fields, Caddyfile subdirectives and Provision, breaking existing configs; adds undocumented aliases and extra rate args to server options beyond what was asked.
rationale.readability: Clear names, small helpers (next, setDeadline, maxChunk), well-commented Server fields; a few doc comments are single 200+ char lines instead of wrapped.
rationale.robustness: Handles nil logger, nil body, downgrades ErrNotSupported to debug, clears deadlines on Hijack/Close, chunked Write/ReadFrom terminate correctly; but the zero-timeout-with-rate path can kill legitimate requests and Close drops the hard read deadline.
rationale.maintainability: Shared IdleDeadline/reader/writer reused by server and handler, but exported mutable Start state and duplicated Caddyfile arg parsing for read/write; doc/code mismatch on MinRate semantics will confuse future edits.
